limitations.wanted: to print the screw as well, and hand in a printed 1/4-20 thumbscrew part alongside the plate
limitations.blocked_by: the submission format: part code has to build a valid CadQuery solid in one shot with no way for me to run it, and generating a real helical 1/4-20 thread (helix sweep) is exactly the kind of thing that silently fails; also the salvaged 1/4-20 bolt is in the hardware list and is strictly better
limitations.why: the user asked about printing "the part that screws in" — a PLA thread would strip in the camera's metal socket and drop the camera, so I want to be explicit that I chose the metal bolt instead, but I would have liked to hand in a printed fallback too

limitations.wanted: to size the dovetail flanks from the actual clamp — the height of the jaws' angled faces and the width across them at floor level
limitations.blocked_by: those two measurements were never returned (the replies repeated the 38 mm plate width and the clamp style), so the flank height had to be inferred
limitations.why: the dovetail has to wedge against those jaws; with the numbers I could match the real clamp instead of falling back on the standard Arca-Swiss 38 mm / 26 mm / 45° profile and a test coupon
